basis: Initial40requests are consumed. The retained old reserve-policy index is incomplete. A newly inspected official monetary-policy-report catalog lists every2013-2023Q4report and2024Q2report, providing a bounded annual cross-check rather than more event discovery by search.
selected_reports: Exactly2013-2023fourth-quarter China Monetary Policy Reports and2024second-quarter report, Chinese original versions. Read reserve-requirement policy sections and policy chronology appendices; no stock-price series or market performance extraction.
request_policy: One catalog, at most one landing page and one originalPDF per selected report. PublicHTTPS GET, TLS validation, no retry or redirect,30second deadline, exclusive per-URL claim before request. Reuse already-retained matching sources if found; no purchases, credentials or posting.
review: Reconcile general announcements, targeted-only measures, multi-tranche implementation, dynamically assessed qualifications and absence of general changes by year. These later annual reports corroborate completeness; they never replace contemporaneous knowledge dates for entries. Missing or contradictory evidence stays unresolved.
